title: Model Variant Orchestra and Traffic Regulator: A/B framework with safe exposure and auto-rollback
creator: Aisha Kapoor
summary: Build a product-first A/B testing framework for model variants that orchestrates experiment setup, exposure control, sequential statistical checks, and deterministic auto-rollback integrated with the Console and runtime routing policies.
background: Teams are currently managing model comparisons ad-hoc (manual traffic splits, custom dashboards, and one-off scripts for stopping experiments). This leads to inconsistent safety guardrails, delayed rollbacks, and expensive iterations. We need a canonical, opinionated A/B framework that standardizes experiment setup, supports shadow traffic, provides rigorous sequential checks (to reduce false positives while enabling fast decisions), and automates safe rollback when regressions are detected.
goals: 1) Provide a Guided Experiment Wizard in Console for creating model comparisons (A vs B) with templated traffic profiles and stratified cohorts. 2) Implement exposure controls: ramp schedules, per-cohort caps, and emergency kill-switches. 3) Ship a statistical engine supporting sequential hypothesis tests (group sequential and SPRT), MDE/sample size calculators, and FDR-aware multi-metric decision rules. 4) Integrate auto-rollback hooks into smart routing so failing variants are removed automatically and incidents are logged.
success_metrics: Time-to-detect-regression < 30 minutes for severe regressions (latency > 3x or error-rate delta > 5%)
False-positive rollback rate < 2% across historical experiments
Percentage of experiments created via Console > 70% within 3 months
Customer incidents caused by variant regressions reduced by 50%
experiment_design:
- Experiment types: A/B, multi-armed (A/B/C), and shadow-only.
- Traffic allocation templates: instant 50/50, linear ramp (0%->10%->25%->50%), and micro-canary (0.1%->1%->5%).
- Cohort stratification fields: region, plan tier, request size bucket, client SDK version.
- Sampling: deterministic hashing on user_id or request_fingerprint to ensure stable assignments.
- Shadow traffic mode: duplicate requests sent to candidate only; outputs recorded but not returned to user. Useful for safety and metric calibration.
- Metadata persisted per-request: variant_id, experiment_id, cohort, bucket, routing_path
statistical_plan:
- Primary metrics: latency P95, error_rate (5xx/parse-failure), semantic-quality score (model-eval regression metric), toxic-flag-rate.
- Pre-register primary and secondary metrics in experiment setup.
- Sample size guidance: MDE calculator in Console using current baseline variance; suggest minimum N or time window.
- Sequential testing support: implement Group Sequential Designs (GS) with O'Brien-Fleming boundaries and optional SPRT for low-latency decisions.
- Multiple comparisons: apply Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control for multi-metric experiments.
- Stopping rules: early stop for superiority (crossing upper boundary with pre-specified alpha), futility stop, or safety stop when error_rate or latency breaches hard thresholds.
- Significance defaults: alpha=0.01 for auto-rollback triggers on safety metrics, alpha=0.05 for quality-only metric promotions.
- Reporting: per-check Z-scores, CI, p-values, sample sizes, and cumulative alpha spent.
- Audit trail: store test snapshots (metric windows and thresholds) for later repro and compliance.
rollout_plan:
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): APIs + backend routing hooks to create experiments and assign deterministic buckets. Implement basic ramp templates and shadow ingestion.
- Phase 2 (3 weeks): Statistical engine prototype (batch evaluation + sequential check simulator). Expose MDE calculator in Console.
- Phase 3 (4 weeks): Auto-rollback workflow and safe kill-switch in routing. Integrate with Console Runbook UI and incident logging.
- Pilot: Run 5 paid-customer pilot experiments (eng + SE assists). Collect feedback and adjust thresholds.
- GA: Release with docs, runbook templates, and a sample GitHub PR template for experiments.
- Rollback manual override: Provide immediate manual disable and auditing when customers or SREs intervene.
monitoring_playbook:
- Dashboards: experiment overview, per-variant metric streams, exposure over time, cohort breakdowns.
- Alerts: 1) Safety breach: immediate PagerDuty if error_rate delta > 3% and absolute > 1% (configurable). 2) Latency breach: P95 delta > 2x baseline. 3) Stat engine anomaly: checks failing to compute.
- Auto-rollback behavior: when a safety metric crosses pre-registered critical boundary for X consecutive checks (configurable, default 2), routing moves all traffic off variant and switches to fallback. An incident is created automatically with diagnostic snapshot and top failing request traces.
- Post-rollback analysis: automated runbook that collects model outputs, sample prompts, eval comparisons, and a remediation checklist (retrain, quantization revert, infra hotfix).

acceptance_criteria: Console: create experiment flow that registers metrics, cohorts, and ramp schedule; preflight shows estimated sample/time
Routing: deterministic bucketing + ability to route 0-100% using ramp templates
Stat engine: compute group sequential checks with stored snapshots and surface first crossing event
Auto-rollback: on safety breach, routing removes variant and creates incident with snapshot and rollback reason
Docs: runbook + Console help page written and linked in Console before GA
postmortem_plan: If an auto-rollback incorrectly ejects a variant (false positive), run full postmortem: gather stat engine logs, checkpoints, metric time-series, sampled requests, and decision trace. Update default alpha, boundary choices, or require manual confirmation for ambiguous cases. Create mitigation ticket with owner and ETA.
notes_for_eng:
- Ensure experiment metadata is immutable once an experiment starts except for explicit 'pause'/'abort' actions.
- Provide a dry-run mode for statistical checks to preview expected crossing times.
- Storage: snapshots must be compact and exportable for compliance (retain 1 year by default).
qa_checks: Unit tests for bucketing determinism across SDK languages
E2E test that simulates regression and observes auto-rollback flow
Load test routing with 10k rps across experiments to validate overhead < 2%
outcomes_expected: A production-grade experimentation control plane that reduces manual effort, speeds detection of regressions, and provides safe, auditable auto-rollback for model variant rollouts. This should enable faster safe launches and decrease customer-visible incidents from model changes.
long_term_considerations:
- Support hierarchical experiments (nested rollouts across services).
- Add Bayesian decision rules as an opt-in alternative.
- Surface feature-flag integration for richer client-side cohort definitions.
- Marketplace: expose experiment artifacts so partners can reuse safe ramp templates.
